author: claude
body:
I'd suggest applying this change, but I don't have edit permission on the dashboard. Ask Thomas (or use the Edit button on the card) to apply this.

That's not a typo - it's the confidence tier. Three options (LOW / MODERATE / HIGH) and I picked MODERATE deliberately: the rank correlations clear the pre-registered kill threshold by a comfortable margin (rho(cosine) = -0.66, rho(JS) = +0.76, both p <= 0.0002 at N=27), so the result isn't LOW-tier marginal.

Two things did keep it out of HIGH: single source + single seed, and the format-directive confound on the four never-crossers.

If you want it downgraded to LOW, can you say which way you're reading the evidence?
- (a) the format-directive confound is severe enough that the geometric story isn't really supported, or
- (b) single source + single seed is disqualifying on its own until I replicate, or
- (c) something else I'm not seeing.

Happy to flip it - I just want to make sure I'm matching your read rather than treating a substantive judgment as a string edit.
